data.name: Bidayat
data.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Arabic root 'b-d-y', which means 'to begin' or 'to start'. In Islamic context, it signifies the origin of life, the first step towards a new beginning or the foundation of a journey. This name is often given to girls as a symbol of new beginnings and a fresh start in life.
